$comment: Which zones the server runs. This is the pluggable bit: add a zone id here, restart, and it is in the game. Ids are the MUD's own zone numbers - see data/world/index.json for all 327.
$velenComment: 100001 'Velen - The Square' joined 2026-08-09: Phase 22's courtyard seed and the first COMMITTED authored zone - its source is data/authored/zones/100001.json in git, worldgen merges it beside the harvest, and the server loads the built file like any harvested zone (file-first routing in GameWorld.load; the A8d shell now serves only zones with no built file, like 100000). It is an island until Phase 27 stitches the roads - reach it by admin teleport. Not in populate: Phase 23 brings its people.
$zoneComment: 36 IceCrag Castle and 168 Kobold Settlement are Duris-matched, so they carry real sector types, room flags and prose from the .wld harvest - 216 of IceCrag's 219 rooms have descriptions and 41 are genuinely dark. 260 The Stag Forest and 261 The Stump Bog are NOT matched (3 of 98 and 0 of 93 rooms), so their terrain is inferred - word and suffix rules plus graph diffusion since Phase 5c - and they have no prose; they stay loaded because they are the only adjacent pair with cross-zone exits, which is what travel between zones is tested against.
$spawnComment: Room 41260 'An Overgrown Field' (zone 168, level 5) is where a new character starts, and it was chosen from the data rather than by eye: no aggressive mob stands in it, nine of its neighbours hold level 2-6 kobolds, and nothing adjacent is above level 3. Grumbiter's Inn - the one safe room in the loaded world - is on the same level. It moved here in Phase 14b from room 281, IceCrag's approach road, because IceCrag's own population runs level 15-60 with a median of 41: a new character spawned there could not win a fight anywhere they could walk to. See docs/DESIGN-progression.md.
$populateComment: Which zones spawn their inhabitants - roadmap Phase 8. Worldgen harvests population for all 49 Duris-matched zones into data/world/spawns/, but a zone only fills if it is listed here, and the reason is art rather than data: LPC's base bodies are humanoids only. Kobold Settlement (168) was deliberately absent for that reason - Duris tags its kobolds with a humanoid race code, so they render as men, and its cows and chickens have no body at all. Phase 14b switched it on anyway, knowingly: it is the only low-level population in the loaded world (93 mobs, minimum level 2, 51 of them level 8 or under), and without it a brand-new character cannot win a single fight. Art fidelity was the cheaper thing to trade, and this is one line to revert the day there is creature art.
$sellingComment: 24 Ashrumite joined 2026-08-07 on the owner's ask ('I would like to sell some of my stash'): it is the nearest Duris-matched zone with keepers who BUY - a weaponsmith (weapons), an armorer (armour), a jeweler and a silversmith (treasure), and a mage shopkeeper (scrolls, wands, potions). The three keepers previously loaded (kobold maid, baker, Grumbiter) all carry empty buy lists - 261 of the 694 harvested shops buy nothing, and all three of ours happened to be among them.
$questComment: 64 Faerie Realm joined 2026-08-08, chosen off REFERENCE-duris-quests.md's harvest list for its quests rather than its geography. It was picked over the doc's own headline candidate: Ashstone Refugee Camp (326) has 20 givers in the .qst but our zMUD map holds only FOUR rooms and two mob resets for it, so not one of its givers spawns and nothing there is shippable. Of the 31 harvested zones with a .qst, Faerie Realm is the only one offering several single-item objectives whose sources all spawn, at a level band a character might survive: 197 rooms, 96 mob resets, levels 4-62 against Jotunheim's median 54, and no fee on any objective, so nothing had to be dropped to fit the schema. See docs/REFERENCE-duris-quests.md.
$walkableComment: The Feywild became walkable on 2026-08-08, on the owner's ask, and it took a measurement plus one authored door. The measurement: across all 327 harvested zones the Faerie Realm sits in a SIX-zone island - 64, 190, 193, 226, 367, 423 - with no walking route to the 268-zone mainland from anywhere, so no amount of loading could ever have connected it. What CAN be loaded is 321 Evermeet- Ancient Forest, 100 rooms that already border the Kobold Settlement in the harvest (41187 'A Game Trail' south to 41185 'A Stand of Ancient Trees', both ways) - the settlement's ONLY harvested neighbour, and until now the loaded world had six disconnected pieces including a kobold zone joined to nothing. The crossing itself is authored in data/world/overrides/links.json: a faerie ring from 41180 deep in that wood to 7691 'A Ring of Rowan Trees', which the map already named and which already drops into Finn's Keep, whose key one of the live quests pays. Population is the honest gap: of the six new zones only 64 has harvested spawns, so Leuthilspar's forest (367) and the Unseelie Court (423) are 471 rooms of fully-described, entirely empty world, and 321/190/226 are largely prose-less as well - loaded on the same terms 260 and 261 already are.
$courtsComment: 226 Seelie Faerie Court and 423 Unseelie Faerie Court joined 2026-08-08 on the owner's ask ('yes populate the courts'). Neither has a harvested spawn file - no Duris .wld matches either, so worldgen never wrote one - and they are the first zones to be populated without a harvest: `emptyZoneSpawns` in server/src/spawns.ts gives such a zone an empty table so its clock runs and authored placements have somewhere to land. Their inhabitants are NOT invented. The zMUD capture preserved each room's contents below its `Exits:` line, so the mapper recorded the actual population - 12 creatures across the Seelie court's three inner chambers, including Tiaronn and Sysoria by name, and 55 content lines across all 288 Unseelie rooms. Names, descriptions and rooms are transcribed from that; only the stat blocks are ours, and each is copied verbatim from a harvested template at the same level. See data/world/overrides/mobs-authored.json.
$squareComment: 100001 joined populate 2026-08-10 - Phase 23: the square's folk are all authored (mobs-authored.json 9000054-59, placements.json), so the zone fills through emptyZoneSpawns exactly as the faerie courts do: four anchor keepers (weaponsmith, armourer, alchemist, the Anchor & Anvil's landlord - shops-authored.json), and two watchmen of Velen standing the future gate posts.
